7303
  
**Overview**
------------


### **About us**


We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.


As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.



**About GSS**  


  

As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate \& Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
### **About the role**


We are looking for a highly motivated Senior HR Operations Specialist who will deliver day\-to\-day quality HR services according to legal and company requirements and be the first point of contact with all HR related matters. In addition, you will be responsible for document, personnel, and employee data management. You will also be engaged in different improvement initiatives where you will have an opportunity to share and implement your ideas. The role is broad and captures many aspects of HR operational processes, team members may be asked to focus on certain aspects within the role.


In your role you will:


* Provide end\-to\-end HR support for the North Asia region (Onboarding, Data Administration, Absence Administration, Exit Management, Benefits Administration, support HR Tools \& Systems, and other employee life cycle activities).
* Register and maintain employee’s data in the HR system, incl. management of the personnel files.
* Support benefits administration for pensions and employee insurance, including enrolment and termination of eligibility, verify eligibility of staff and dependents and associated invoices.
* Communicate effectively both verbally and in written form with Asia employees.
* Have a strong focus on customer experience improvement KPIs with high attention to time and quality standards.
* Must maintain a high level of confidentiality and adhere to local and global data protection norms.
* Work collaboratively with other team members within the HR Operations Team to share ideas for the continuous improvement of processes, incl. cooperation with the European Global Centre \& Regional Centers / Local Country offices.
* Ensure frequent review/governance on data quality on all HR Systems (completeness and correctness of data).
### **What we offer**


* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance.
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave).
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up).
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance).
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme).
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement).
* Company bonus/Profit share.


\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*


DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture, and we invite you to be part of this diversity.


### **About you**


* 5\-7 years of experience in end\-to\-end HR Operations managing Employee life Cycle and Employee Data management
* Bachelor’s degree required in related field.
* Strong knowledge of the HR system landscape (Service Management Tool, Basware invoicing, Oracle HCM, Oracle on premise solution be an advantage).
* Experience from Shared Services organization supporting a number of countries will be an advantage.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Suite required.
* Be enthusiastic, passionate and keen on learning with a ‘can\-do’ attitude.
* Excellent written and oral communication in English is required; other languages will be an advantage.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.*
**Benefits**
------------


Please note, benefits may depend on your contract type, please confirm with your recruiter.


### **Profit Share**


You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year\-end results.


### **Professional Development**


We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.


### **Hybrid Work Model**


We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you.


### **Global Opportunities**


We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating.


### **Modern Office in Pune**


Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high\-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.


### **Integration Events**


Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well\-integrated team is a well\-functioning team.

  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------


At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.


Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

  

**Working here**
----------------


Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future.


At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn.

Key responsibilities include advancing consistent hiring practices and governance, fostering collaboration and the exchange of best practices across markets, and ensuring the organization is well positioned to meet current and future talent needs in support of business growth.


The Director will define and execute the regional early careers talent acquisition strategy, partnering closely with business leaders, Colleague Strategic Partners (HR Business Partners), Recruitment Marketing, the Programs Center of Excellence, and other enterprise stakeholders to attract, assess, and hire exceptional early career talent. This leader will build innovative sourcing strategies, strengthen strategic university partnerships, elevate the employer brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for candidates, hiring leaders, and recruiters across internships and full\-time campus hiring.


Success in this role requires a strategic, externally focused leader with deep expertise across India and Asia Pacific who can translate enterprise strategy into scalable regional execution. The ideal candidate will combine commercial acumen, operational excellence, and exceptional people leadership to build sustainable early talent pipelines, lead a high\-performing regional team, and advance American Express' position as an employer of choice across the region.


  
* 10\+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience, including significant leadership **experience in Campus or Early Careers recruitment across India and Asia Pacific.**

* Deep understanding of university recruitment ecosystems across India and key Asia Pacific markets, with strong knowledge of regional talent trends and competitive landscapes.
* Strong operational leadership experience using data, analytics, governance, and process excellence to improve recruiting performance and business outcomes.

title: Corporate Consulting Analyst
description:
We are seeking an India\-based legally qualified professionals (Legal Executives / Corporate Consultant/ Law Graduates / Qualified Lawyers) to support our UK\-qualified solicitors in delivering high\-quality, compliant, and efficient legal services. This role will be strictly limited to unreserved legal activities. All work will be supervised by a UK\-qualified Solicitor. The legal executive must adhere to the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) regulatory boundaries and comply with strict confidentiality and data\-handling protocols.

* Role Purpose

The legal executive will provide high\-quality support to UK\-qualified solicitors. The role is focused strictly on unreserved legal activities, performed under direct supervision of UK\-qualified solicitors, in accordance with Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) rules. The legal executive will assist with document handling, client communication, drafting, research, case progression, and operational support relating to CICA matters.

***The role requires strong analytical skills, excellent written communication, high attention to detail, and a disciplined approach to confidentiality and data protection.***

* Key Responsibilities (Unreserved Activities Only)

The legal executive will perform only unreserved tasks, including but not limited to:

* Case Support and Administration
* Assist with day\-to\-day management of CICA claim files.
* Maintain case records, track deadlines, and ensure accuracy of file documentation.
* Support evidence gathering, including obtaining client information, medical records, police reports, and related documents.
* Drafting and Document Preparation
* Draft unreserved correspondence, statements, summaries, chronologies, and research memos for review by a supervising UK solicitor.
* Prepare initial drafts of CICA claim forms, schedules, and supporting submissions (subject to UK solicitor approval).
* Conduct document review and organise evidence bundles.
* Client Liaison (Within Defined Scope)
* Communicate with clients regarding factual updates and requests for information.
* Manage routine follow\-ups with clients to obtain documentation or clarify factual details.
* Ensure all client communications are properly documented and escalated to supervising solicitors where necessary.
* Legal Research and Analysis
* Perform research relating to CICA Scheme provisions, guidance materials, and procedural updates.
* Summarize key findings for supervising UK solicitors to support case strategy.
* Operational and Compliance Support
* Adhere to internal policies on confidentiality, GDPR, IT security, and secure handling of sensitive personal data.
* Maintain accurate time recording and workflow documentation as required.
* Ensure that all tasks remain strictly within the scope of unreserved legal work and escalate any borderline matters immediately.
* Prohibited (Reserved) Activities

In compliance with SRA regulatory requirements, the legal executive must not, under any circumstances:

* Provide reserved legal advice or independent legal opinions.
* Exercise rights of audience or conduct litigation.
* Issue proceedings, file formal court documents, or communicate with tribunals as a representative.
* Engage in conduct reserved to authorised persons under the Legal Services Act 2007\.
* Hold themselves out as a UK solicitor or authorised person.
* Make strategic or settlement decisions without instruction from a supervising UK solicitor.

All work must remain firmly within the unreserved scope and be subject to UK solicitor oversight.

* Required Skills and Competencies
* Strong understanding of legal processes, particularly personal injury or compensation\-based claims (experience with CICA preferred).
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.**
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fully remote environment.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information securely.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation capabilities.
* Proficiency with MS Office, document\-management tools, and secure IT practices.
* Qualifications and Experience
* Law degree (LLB or equivalent) from a recognised institution in India.
* **Prior experience working as a legal executive or legal analyst supporting UK, US, or common\-law jurisdictions is preferred.**
* **Experience in personal injury, compensation claims, or investigative legal work is an advantage.**
* Familiarity with the CICA Scheme is desirable but not essential; training will be provided.
* Reporting and Supervision Framework
* The legal executive will be fully supervised by an assigned UK\-qualified solicitor.
* All work outputs must be reviewed, approved, and directed by a UK solicitor before external use.
* The legal executive must participate in scheduled supervision calls, workflow reviews, and QA processes.
* Escalation protocols must be followed for any issue involving legal judgement, case strategy, compliance risk, or reserved\-activity boundaries.
* Data Protection and Information Security

Given the sensitive nature of CICA work, the following standards must be strictly adhered to:

* Compliance with UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, and internal data\-security protocols.
* Use of approved secure systems for document storage, communication, and case handling.
* Prohibition on use of personal devices or unsecure networks for work\-related activities.
* Mandatory training in confidentiality, cyber\-security, and information\-handling practices.
* Working Arrangements
* Remote working arrangement from India via employer Reighway.
* Standard working hours aligned to UK business hours, unless otherwise agreed.
* Participation in virtual team meetings, supervision sessions, and ongoing professional development.
* Occasional flexibility may be required to align with UK case deadlines or client needs.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Accuracy and quality of drafted documents.
* Compliance with SRA\-aligned processes and regulatory boundaries.
* Timeliness in completing assigned tasks.
* Responsiveness and reliability in supervised workflows.
* Adherence to confidentiality, GDPR, and internal information\-security standards.
* Positive feedback from supervising UK solicitors.

**Important Note:** *Candidates are expected to attend the interview having prepared an overview and working understanding of CICA claims and procedures, together with an awareness of the relevant regulatory requirements of the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)*

**Role**

  

The Data Analyst is an individual contributor role that develops foundational proficiency in one or more workflows or
  

datasets. The role supports end\-to\-end data lifecycle activities including sourcing, basic validation, enrichment, and delivery under
  

guidance, adhering strictly to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and set guidelines, and escalating deviations for a defined
  

dataset or workflow.
  

The role emphasizes building strong data literacy and operational discipline, learning industry concepts, and collaborating with other
  

data research teams. Associates contribute to UAT and day\-to\-day solutioning, follow established standards, and participate in
  

continuous process improvement and the adoption of technology and AI\-enabled workflows.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**  



  

**Operational Delivery**


* Collect, extract, and cleanse data for assigned workflows or datasets from structured and unstructured sources.
* Execute sourcing, tagging, loading, and basic enrichment activities in strict adherence to SOPs, rule books, and predefined
* validation checks.
* Execute day\-to\-day data collection, extraction, and basic cleansing using approved manual and AI\-assisted methodologies.
* Record production accurately in workflow and queue management tools, ensuring clear notes for traceability and handovers.
* Monitor assigned queues and proactively flag delays, blockers, data gaps, or unusual patterns for senior team members.
* Operate within approved rules and workflows; pause processing and escalate promptly when inputs deviate, or sources are
* unclear.
* Meet defined daily and weekly production and quality targets for assigned queues.
* Provide clear logs and supporting evidence to enable basic root\-cause analysis when issues occur.
  

  

**Process Excellence**


* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and follow established handover protocols and controls.

title: Junior Equity Research Analyst
description:
**NIRALUSHA INVESTMENTS**

**Equity Research Analyst – Technical, Fundamental \& Macro**

*Junior / Associate Level* ***0–3 Years Experience***  *Full\-Time, In\-Office* ***Reports to: Founder / Portfolio Manager***

**Location**

In\-office, Science City Road Ahmedabad 380060

**Employment Type**

Full\-time, permanent

**Experience**

0–3 years (freshers with strong self\-taught market knowledge and a demonstrable track record are welcome)

**Reports To**

Founder / Senior Portfolio Manager

**Team**

Investment Research \& Portfolio Management

**About the Role**

Niralusha Investments is looking for a sharp, independent\-minded Equity Research Analyst to join our investment team. This is a hands\-on research role — you will study companies, sectors, and markets from every angle (technical, fundamental, and macroeconomic), form clear and well\-supported views, and directly influence how client portfolios are built, monitored, and rebalanced. We want someone who can defend a position with data and conviction, not just report facts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. 360° Research \& Analysis**

● Conduct end\-to\-end research on stocks combining technical analysis, fundamental analysis (financial statements, ratios, valuation, management quality, competitive positioning) and macro/micro economic conditions (interest rates, inflation, currency, policy, global cues, industry cycles).

● Track and interpret economic data releases (RBI/Fed policy, GDP, inflation, IIP, PMI, global commodity and currency trends) and translate them into actionable sector and stock views.

● Identify sectoral rotation and emerging themes early — spot which sectors are gaining or losing relative strength and why.

**2\. Technical \& Chart\-Based Research**

● Perform manual stock screening (not just running pre\-built scanners) across market caps and sectors to surface actionable candidates.

● Mark demand and supply zones, support/resistance, and trend structure across multiple timeframes (weekly, daily, hourly/intraday) using price action, volume, and market structure.

● Apply momentum and swing trading techniques to identify entry, exit, and risk\-management levels for tactical positions.

● Combine technical setups with fundamental and macro context so trade/investment ideas are backed by more than one lens.

**3\. Portfolio Monitoring \& Client Support**

● Continuously monitor existing client portfolio holdings, flagging deterioration, opportunity, or risk\-concentration issues proactively.

● Recommend and justify portfolio changes (additions, exits, rebalancing, hedges) aimed at outperforming relevant benchmark indices.

● Deep\-dive into individual holdings on request — building a complete research case (thesis, risks, valuation, technical levels) that can be presented to the investment team or clients.

**4\. Conviction, Communication \& Decision Support**

● Form and clearly articulate well\-reasoned, opinionated investment views — be able to make the case for (or against) an idea persuasively and back it with evidence when challenged.

● Present research findings in a structured, concise format (written notes and verbal discussion) to support investment committee decisions.

● Maintain a research log / idea tracker and follow up on the performance of past calls to build an accountable track record.

**5\. Market Recall \& Composure Under Pressure**

● Keep a sharp, near real\-time mental map of key stock prices, levels, open positions, and client portfolio holdings — able to recall specifics instantly in a discussion without stopping to look everything up.

● Make fast, sound decisions during volatile, fast\-moving sessions (gap opens, event\-driven spikes, sudden reversals) — acting decisively within tight windows rather than freezing or hesitating.

● Treat volatility as opportunity, not threat — stay calm and clear\-headed exactly when the market is at its most chaotic, while still respecting risk and position sizing.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

● Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Business, Engineering, or a related field (MBA/CFA/CMT pursuing or completed is a strong plus, not mandatory for junior level).

● Solid working knowledge of technical analysis: chart patterns, trend structure, support/resistance, demand\-supply zones, indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, volume analysis).

● Solid working knowledge of fundamental analysis: reading financial statements (P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow), valuation methods (DCF, relative valuation), and business/industry analysis.

● Genuine interest in and working understanding of macroeconomics — able to connect interest rates, inflation, currency, and global events to sector and stock impact.

● Comfortable with manual research and screening — not solely reliant on automated tools or third\-party recommendations.

● Strong, well\-supported opinions with the confidence and communication skills to defend them in discussion — while remaining open to being proven wrong by data.

● Proficiency with charting/screening platforms (e.g., TradingView, Chartink, brokerage terminals) and Excel/Google Sheets for analysis.

● Personal trading/investing track record, portfolio simulations, or demonstrable market involvement will count strongly in your favour, even without formal work experience.

● High integrity and discretion — this role involves direct influence over client money.

● Excellent recall for numbers — prices, levels, position sizes, and portfolio details — and the mental bandwidth to track multiple open positions and client books simultaneously.

● Demonstrated ability to think and act quickly under pressure; genuinely energised (not rattled) by volatile, fast\-moving markets.

● Calm, level\-headed temperament — able to make high\-stakes calls in seconds during sharp moves without panicking or freezing.

**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**

● NISM certifications (Research Analyst / Investment Adviser modules), CFA Level 1\+, or CMT Level 1\+.

● Prior internship or work experience at a broking firm, PMS, AIF, mutual fund, or proprietary trading desk.

● A public or demonstrable body of market research/writing (blog, newsletter, social media analysis, etc.).

● Familiarity with sector rotation frameworks, intermarket analysis, and multi\-timeframe trading systems.

**What Niralusha Investments Offers**

● Direct mentorship and fast\-tracked learning working closely with the founder/senior decision\-makers on live portfolio calls.

● Ownership of research areas/sectors and visible impact on real client outcomes from day one.

● A meritocratic environment where well\-reasoned, correct calls are recognised and rewarded.

● Growth path toward senior analyst / portfolio manager responsibilities based on performance.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit:

● An updated resume/CV.

● A short write\-up (1 page max) with a current stock or sector view — including technical levels (with demand/supply zone marking), fundamental rationale, and the macro backdrop supporting the view.

● Any evidence of prior market involvement (portfolio track record, blog, certifications, internship reports).

**Job Description**

**GET Trainee – Engine Durability Engineer**
============================================


### **3W Powertrain \| CNG \| Petrol \| Flex\-Fuel**


**Position Overview**
---------------------


We are looking for a **GET Trainee – Engine Durability Engineer** to support engine durability testing, validation, test data analysis, component inspection, and failure investigation activities for **3W CNG, Petrol, and Flex\-Fuel powertrains**.


The trainee will work closely with experienced engineers and testing teams and will gain hands\-on exposure to **engine dynamometer testing, durability test cycles, engine performance monitoring, test instrumentation, post\-test teardown inspection, failure analysis, and validation activities**.


The role is suitable for a Mechanical/Automobile Engineering graduate with a strong interest in **IC engines, powertrain development, testing, and durability engineering**.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **1\. Engine Durability Testing**


* Support execution of **engine durability and endurance tests** on engine dynamometers and vehicles.
* Execute assigned durability test cycles as per approved test procedures and schedules.
* Support performance, endurance, overload, thermal, and other engine validation tests.
* Monitor engine operating conditions throughout the test.
* Ensure proper test preparation, instrumentation, data acquisition, and test documentation.
* Coordinate with test technicians and senior engineers for smooth execution of durability tests.

### **2\. Monitoring of Engine Durability Parameters**


Monitor and record critical parameters during durability testing, including:


* Engine speed and torque
* Oil pressure and oil temperature
* Coolant / cylinder head temperature
* Fuel consumption
* Oil consumption
* Blow\-by
* Exhaust emissions
* Engine temperatures
* Fuel rail pressure for CNG engines
* Engine performance and torque/power degradation
* Abnormal noise, vibration, leakage, or other observations

Identify abnormal trends and immediately communicate deviations to the concerned engineer.


### **3\. Test Data Analysis**


* Collect, organize, and analyze data generated from **engine dynamometer and vehicle durability testing**.
* Analyze test trends using **MS Excel** and other relevant engineering tools.
* Prepare graphs, trend plots, data summaries, and test reports.
* Compare pre\-test and post\-test performance to identify degradation.
* Identify abnormal trends in temperature, pressure, oil consumption, blow\-by, performance, emissions, and other durability parameters.
* Support correlation of test results with component condition and failure observations.

### **4\. Post\-Durability Teardown \& Inspection**


* Support teardown of engines after completion of durability tests.
* Inspect critical engine components for wear, damage, deformation, overheating, leakage, and abnormal conditions.
* Support measurement and documentation of component wear.
* Compare inspection results against drawings, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify and document abnormal wear patterns and failure indications.
* Prepare **post\-durability teardown and inspection reports**.

### **5\. Failure Analysis \& Root Cause Investigation**


* Support investigation of component failures and durability issues.
* Participate in structured problem\-solving using:
	+ 5\-Why analysis
	+ Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis
	+ Failure Mode analysis
	+ Basic FMEA methodology
* Develop understanding of common engine durability failure mechanisms, including:
	+ Valve seat recession
	+ Valve train wear
	+ Piston and piston\-ring wear
	+ Cylinder scuffing
	+ Bearing wear
	+ Crankshaft / connecting rod issues
	+ Lubrication failures
	+ Thermal fatigue
	+ Excessive oil consumption
	+ Blow\-by increase
	+ Cooling system\-related failures
* Support corrective and preventive action evaluation under guidance from senior engineers.

### **6\. CNG, Petrol \& Flex\-Fuel Engine Durability**


* Develop practical understanding of durability characteristics of **CNG, Petrol, and Flex\-Fuel engines**.
* Support durability evaluation of CNG fuel\-system components and engine systems.
* Monitor CNG fuel rail pressure and other relevant fuel\-system parameters.
* Understand the effect of different fuels on:
	+ Combustion
	+ Engine temperature
	+ Lubrication
	+ Valve and valve\-seat durability
	+ Piston/ring durability
	+ Engine performance
	+ Emissions
* Support evaluation of engine durability under different operating conditions and fuel types.

### **7\. Performance \& Durability Correlation**


* Support comparison of **pre\-durability and post\-durability engine performance**.
* Analyze changes in:
	+ Power
	+ Torque
	+ Fuel consumption
	+ Oil consumption
	+ Blow\-by
	+ Emissions
	+ Thermal behavior
* Support identification of performance degradation and its possible relationship with component wear or failure.

### **8\. Validation \& Documentation**


Prepare and maintain:


* Durability test plans and schedules
* Test checklists
* Test data records
* Durability test reports
* Teardown reports
* Component inspection reports
* Data analysis sheets
* DVP\&R execution records
* Failure analysis reports
* Validation status reports

Maintain proper traceability of test engines, test conditions, test hours/kilometers, test results, and component inspection findings.


**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------


* Basic to good understanding of **Internal Combustion Engines and 3W Powertrains**.
* Basic understanding of:
	+ Engine combustion
	+ Lubrication system
	+ Cooling system
	+ Valve train
	+ Piston\-cylinder assembly
	+ Crank train
	+ Fuel systems
	+ Ignition system
	+ Exhaust and emission systems
* Understanding of engine performance and durability parameters.
* Basic knowledge of engine dynamometer testing.
* Basic understanding of engineering measurements and component inspection.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and specifications.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel** for data analysis and reporting.
* Basic knowledge of **5\-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, and problem\-solving techniques**.
* Exposure to data acquisition and engine test instrumentation will be an advantage.

**Desired Competencies**
------------------------


* Strong interest in **Engine Testing, Durability, and Powertrain Development**.
* Analytical approach and ability to interpret test data.
* Strong observation and attention to detail.
* Good problem\-solving capability.
* Willingness to work hands\-on in **engine test cells and vehicle testing environments**.
* Ability to identify abnormal engine behavior and communicate observations clearly.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Testing, Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and Supplier teams.
* Willingness to learn and take increasing responsibility for assigned durability activities.

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------


**Education:**


* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Automobile Engineering.

**Experience:**


* **GET / Fresher – 0 to 1 year experience.**
* Internship or academic project experience in **IC engines, engine testing, powertrain, vehicle testing, or durability engineering** will be an advantage.

**Learning \& Development Exposure**
------------------------------------


During the training period, the GET will gain exposure to:


* 3W CNG, Petrol, and Flex\-Fuel engines
* Engine dynamometer testing
* Engine durability and endurance testing
* Test cycles and test\-bed operation
* Engine test instrumentation and data acquisition
* Engine performance evaluation
* Post\-durability teardown and component inspection
* Engine failure analysis
* CNG fuel\-system durability
* Emission and regulatory requirements
* DVP\&R and validation processes
* Powertrain durability development
* Vehicle\-level durability correlation

**Key Success Measures**
------------------------


The GET trainee will progressively demonstrate the ability to:


* Execute assigned durability tests safely and correctly.
* Accurately record and maintain test data.
* Monitor critical engine durability parameters.
* Identify and report abnormal test trends.
* Perform basic test\-data analysis.
* Support post\-durability teardown and component inspection.
* Identify basic wear and failure patterns.
* Prepare clear and accurate durability reports.
* Support root\-cause investigations using structured problem\-solving methods.
* Develop a strong understanding of **3W engine durability and powertrain validation**.
* Take increasing ownership of assigned durability testing activities.

title: Engineer, Information Security (ForgeRock)
description:
**About Lowe’s**




 Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion. Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.
 



  





 At Lowe's India, we are the enablers who help create an engaging customer experience for our $90\+ billion home improvement business at Lowe's. Our 4000\+ associates work across technology, analytics, business operations, finance \& accounting, product management, and shared services. We leverage new technologies and find innovative methods to ensure that Lowe's has a competitive edge in the market. To know more about Lowe's India, visit Lowes.co.in
 



  





**Job Summary**




 We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer with a strong focus on authentication and authorization to join our team. This role will be responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of IAM solutions, particularly in the areas of authentication protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML 2\.0\), integration with Identity Provider
 



  





 ForgeRock, and supporting LDAP\-based directory services. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Java development to support customizations and enhancements of IAM systems, a deep understanding of IAM best practices, and a proactive approach to ensuring the security and scalability of our access management systems. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure and efficient IAM solutions across on\-prem and cloud environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* **Core Role:** 
 Design, implement, and maintain information security tools and services in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) domain, with a primary focus on authentication and authorization solutions.



  




* **IAM Products:** 
 Support and manage enterprise\-level IAM systems and services as ForgeRock and other Identity Providers (IdPs). Demonstrate expertise in configuring, troubleshooting, and enhancing these systems to meet security and access management requirements.



  




* **Authentication Standards:** 
 Ensure the adoption and implementation of authentication standards (e.g., OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2\.0\). Translate organizational requirements into appropriate authentication and authorization frameworks.



  




* **LDAP Knowledge:** 
 Apply a solid understanding of LDAP concepts, integration with enterprise directories, and their role in IAM systems. Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain LDAP\-based access management environments.



  




* **System Design \& Deployment:** 
 Collaborate with the engineering and security teams to design, deploy, and operate secure authentication solutions across the organization. Develop and document IAM\-related policies, processes, and procedures in line with best practices.



  




* **Security Monitoring \& Incident Response:** 
 Assist the Information Security team with monitoring security systems, analyzing logs, identifying vulnerabilities, and addressing escalated security incidents. Support incident response efforts related to IAM solutions.



  




* **Cross\-team Collaboration:** 
 Partner with other teams to design and implement secure solutions for various enterprise applications and infrastructure components.



  




* **Cloud IAM Integration:** 
 Assist in integrating IAM solutions with cloud technologies and platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). Ensure secure identity and access management in hybrid or cloud\-native environments.



  




* **Continuous Learning \& Development:** 
 Stay up to date with the latest technological advancements in IAM, security standards, and cybersecurity best practices. Participate in continuing education related to identity access management and information security.



  




* **Security Best Practices:** 
 Contribute to secure coding initiatives by developing secure enhancements and using security best practices to mitigate vulnerabilities. Ensure compliance with security standards in all IAM\-related activities.



  




* **Cybersecurity Tools \& Threat Management:** 
 Analyze the output of industry\-standard cybersecurity tools (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM systems) to identify threats and reduce risk exposure. Develop strategies to address IAM\-related security weaknesses.



  




* **Incident Management** 
 : Assist in the implementation of proactive IAM measures and contribute to security breach response procedures. Aid in the management of incidents by diagnosing, troubleshooting, and remediating IAM security issues.



  




* **Custom Enhancements \& Documentation:** 
 Assist in custom development using Java or other relevant programming languages for enhancements in IAM systems. Contribute to technical documentation in a software development environment, ensuring compliance with IAM best practices.



  




* **Vendor \& Product Support:** 
 Collaborate with vendors and product teams for troubleshooting, maintenance, and the enhancement of IAM products and services. Ensure proper documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.



  





**Required Qualifications**



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* At least 3 years of experience in technology system support, software development, or a related field, with at least 2 years of experience in information security applications and systems, specifically IAM.
* Strong working knowledge of Identity and Access Management concepts, including authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Hands\-on experience with IAM product ForgeRock. Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and manage these systems in enterprise environments.
* Solid understanding of LDAP, including its role in directory services and user authentication management.
* Knowledge of authentication protocols like OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML 2\.0, and the ability to implement these protocols in IAM environments.
* Experience with API security and integration using JSON, REST, and web services.
* Java development experience for customizations and enhancements of IAM systems, including writing secure, maintainable code to support authentication and authorization workflows.
* Knowledge of IAM solutions in Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how IAM integrates within those platforms.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical processes and contribute to knowledge sharing.



  





**Preferred Qualifications**



* Master’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience with development life cycles (SDLC) and working on projects involving IAM system implementations.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, CISA, OSCP, CompTIA Security\+ or equivalent IAM/security certifications.
* Hands\-on experience analyzing cybersecurity tools (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM tools) and identifying remediation actions to reduce risk.
* Advanced understanding of information security practices, policies, and standards related to IAM.
* Experience with ITIL or other IT service management frameworks.
* Experience with multi\-cloud IAM deployments or hybrid environments, ensuring security and access management are consistent across on\-prem and cloud infrastructures.

title: Associate Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Job Title:** Associate Technical Support Consultant
  

**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 year
  

**Location:** Pune, India
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  

**Department:** Technical Support / Customer Support


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and technically inclined **Associate Technical Support Consultant** to join our Technical Support team. This is an entry\-level opportunity for a fresher who is passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and helping customers.


The successful candidate will receive training on our enterprise healthcare software products and support processes and will work closely with experienced consultants to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues.


The role provides an opportunity to develop expertise in **enterprise applications, databases, interfaces, application troubleshooting, incident management, and healthcare IT systems** .


**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide **first\-level technical support** to customers using enterprise healthcare software applications.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application and technical issues reported through **ServiceNow or other ticketing systems** .
* Analyse reported problems by gathering relevant information, reviewing logs, identifying error messages, and following established troubleshooting procedures.
* Follow documented **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Knowledge Articles, and troubleshooting guides** to resolve common issues.
* Perform basic application configuration, validation, and troubleshooting activities under the guidance of senior team members.
* Collaborate with senior technical consultants, development, infrastructure, database, interface, and other technical teams when additional expertise is required.
* Maintain accurate and detailed case documentation, including troubleshooting steps, findings, resolution, and customer communication.
* Meet defined **SLA, productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction** expectations.
* Participate in knowledge\-transfer sessions and continuously build knowledge of supported products.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute ideas for improving **knowledge articles, SOPs, automation, and support processes** .
* Use available tools, documentation, and **AI\-assisted troubleshooting capabilities** responsibly to improve investigation efficiency and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams through email, chat, and support calls.
* Participate in rotational shifts, including evening/night/weekend coverage, based on business requirements.
* Escalate critical or high\-impact issues promptly and ensure appropriate follow\-up until resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical discipline** .
* Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Basic understanding of:
	+ Operating systems, particularly Windows
	+ Networking fundamentals
	+ Databases and SQL concepts
	+ Application troubleshooting
	+ Software development/support concepts
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Flexible to work during U.S shift timings with certain weekend on call.

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
About Chennai Nest

Chennai Nest is a growing Chennai\-based rental property sourcing and coordination service. We help tenants discover suitable rental homes and coordinate enquiries, property information, site visits and bookings with property owners and agents.

We are looking for a responsible and organised **Customer Relationship Executive** to help us manage our growing number of customer enquiries and property site visits.

Role Overview

This is a **full\-time remote role** based in Chennai.

You will be the first point of contact for many Chennai Nest customers and will be responsible for managing enquiries, qualifying leads, coordinating site visits, maintaining lead records and following up with potential customers.

This is primarily a **customer coordination and operations role**, not a traditional field\-sales/broker role.

Key Responsibilities

* Respond to customer enquiries through WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels.
* Understand customer requirements such as location, budget, BHK, family/bachelor preference, number of people and move\-in date.
* Share suitable property details with customers.
* Coordinate and schedule property site visits.
* Maintain the Chennai Nest lead and site\-visit database.
* Use Google Sheets, Google Forms and Google Calendar to manage leads and appointments.
* Send site\-visit confirmations, reminders and location details.
* Follow up with customers after site visits.
* Identify serious/high\-intent customers and escalate them to the founder for negotiation or booking.
* Coordinate with property owners and other agents when required.
* Keep track of available, booked and unavailable properties.
* Follow up with older leads when suitable new properties become available.
* Maintain accurate notes for every customer and site visit.
* Provide a daily update on enquiries, site visits, hot leads, follow\-ups and bookings.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Good at speaking with customers over the phone.
* Comfortable communicating in Tamil and English.
* Patient, polite and professional.
* Highly organised and good at follow\-ups.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp and WhatsApp Web.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Forms and Google Calendar.
* Able to manage multiple site visits and enquiries at the same time.
* Good at understanding customer requirements.
* Able to identify serious customers from casual enquiries.
* Responsible with customer information.
* Comfortable working independently from home.
* Willing to learn Chennai's residential areas and rental market.
* Able to follow processes and maintain accurate records.

Experience

**1–3 years of experience preferred**, especially in:

* Customer support
* Telecalling
* Inside sales
* Real estate coordination
* Sales coordination
* Front office/customer service
* Operations/admin coordination

Real estate experience is an advantage but **not mandatory**.

Freshers with excellent communication, organisation and customer\-handling skills may also be considered.

Working Schedule

**Tuesday to Sunday**  
**11:00 AM to 8:00 PM**

**Monday – Weekly Off**

Sunday availability is important because Chennai Nest receives a high number of rental enquiries and site visits on weekends.

Work Arrangement

**Remote / Work From Home**

A dedicated Chennai Nest phone/number and the required digital tools will be provided as needed for the role.

The employee must have a reliable internet connection and a suitable environment for customer calls.

Salary will depend on experience, communication skills, organisational ability and performance.

What We Value

We value:

* Honesty
* Reliability
* Fast response
* Good communication
* Customer empathy
* Follow\-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Willingness to learn

The right person will have the opportunity to take significant ownership of Chennai Nest's customer coordination and site\-visit operations as the business grows.

Important

This role involves handling customer enquiries and coordinating property visits. It requires regular phone communication and consistent follow\-up during working hours.

If you enjoy speaking with people, organising information and helping customers find suitable homes, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Customer relationship management: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Karmè Social \| Hyderabad \| Full\-time**

We are a brand marketing and social agency building D2C and premium lifestyle brands that people actually feel something about. We are looking for a Brand Manager who thinks like a consumer psychologist and works like a producer.

**What you will own**

* Brand strategy and positioning for 3 to 5 client accounts: audience psychographics, brand voice, category gaps, messaging architecture
* Content strategy that ships: monthly calendars, reel briefs, carousel structures, campaign concepts mapped to awareness, consideration and conversion
* Copy and creative direction: hooks, captions, ad copy, scripts, landing page messaging
* Meta ads support: creative briefs, angle testing, reading performance and rewriting what is not working
* Client relationships: presenting strategy, defending ideas, taking feedback without losing the plot
* Execution accountability: coordinating designers, editors and photographers so decks turn into live posts, not pending tasks

**Who this is for**

* Someone genuinely enthu about brands. You notice packaging, you screenshot ads, you have opinions on why a campaign worked
* Confident in a room. You can pitch your idea to a founder and hold your ground with reasoning, not volume
* You love execution as much as ideating. Big ideas are easy. Shipping them on a Tuesday with three revisions pending is the actual job
* You understand real human consumer psychology: why people buy, what they say they want vs what they actually pay for, what triggers a save, a share, a DM
* Strong writing instinct in English. Telugu or Hindi fluency is a plus for local campaign work

**Who this is not for**

* Not for AI paglus. Use tools to move faster, not to think for you. If your strategy deck reads like a prompt output, we will know in the first paragraph
* No copy paste. Not from Pinterest boards, not from competitor pages, not from last year's calendar
* Not for people who need to be chased for deadlines or need a brief for every brief

**Experience**  
1 to 3 years in an agency, D2C brand or personal brand marketing role. Freshers with an exceptional portfolio and real proof of thinking will be considered.

**Logistics**  
Currently remote or hybrid. We are shifting into an office space soon, so Hyderabad\-based candidates or those willing to relocate are preferred.

**How to apply**  
Send your CV plus answer the following by emailing to meghana@karmesocial.com

* A brand you think is doing marketing wrong, and what you would change in 3 bullet points
* A campaign or content piece you built end to end, with the thinking behind it
* Applications without the second part will not be reviewed.

Pay: Up to ₹30,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Why you? Why with us?
* What's one thing Karmè would miss if you didnot become part of the team?
* Do you own a laptop?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**

Role Overview

As a Sales \& Marketing Intern, you will work closely with the management team across **sales, marketing, brand activation, social media, customer engagement, and business development**.

This is a hands\-on role. You won't just be sitting at a desk—you'll get exposure to how brands are marketed, how customers make purchase decisions, how retail sales work, and how a growing business builds its brand.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Business Development

* Support day\-to\-day sales initiatives across JP Liquor Mart outlets.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to increase sales and customer engagement.
* Track sales performance, product movement, and promotional performance.
* Assist with customer feedback and understanding purchasing preferences.
* Support relationships with brand representatives, distributors, and partners.
* Help execute promotional campaigns and in\-store activations.

Marketing \& Social Media

* Assist in planning and executing Instagram and other social media campaigns.
* Create ideas for reels, posts, stories, promotions, and brand collaborations.
* Coordinate with photographers, designers, influencers, and content creators.
* Research current trends in the **liquor, hospitality, lifestyle, food \& beverage, and premium consumer markets**.
* Help develop creative campaigns for new product launches and seasonal promotions.
* Monitor social media performance and prepare basic reports.

Market \& Competitor Research

* Research competing liquor retailers, premium brands, bars, restaurants, and lifestyle businesses.
* Track new product launches and emerging beverage trends.
* Identify interesting marketing campaigns and opportunities for JP Liquor Mart.
* Prepare simple presentations and reports for management.

Events \& Brand Activations

* Assist in organizing tastings, product launches, promotional events, and customer experiences.
* Coordinate with brand partners and vendors.
* Help manage event execution from planning through completion.

Management Support

* Work directly with the management team on special projects.
* Prepare presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and marketing proposals.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and ensure timely execution.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* **Confident, energetic, and outgoing**
* Excellent at communication and interpersonal skills
* Interested in **sales, marketing, branding, entrepreneurship, and consumer businesses**
* Comfortable speaking to customers and business partners
* Creative and naturally curious
* Active on social media and understands digital trends
* Comfortable with **Instagram, Canva, Excel/Google Sheets, and PowerPoint**
* Willing to travel locally when required
* Organized and capable of working independently
* Hungry to learn and take responsibility

A Great Fit If You...

You're the kind of person who sees a product in a store and thinks:

**"Why is this selling? Who is buying it? How could we market it better?"**

You don't need to know everything about liquor. **We can teach you the category.**

What matters more is your attitude, curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to get your hands dirty.

What You Will Learn

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* Sales \& retail operations
* Consumer behaviour
* Premium brand marketing
* Social media marketing
* Influencer marketing
* Product launches
* Event management
* Business development
* Market research
* Brand partnerships
* Entrepreneurship and business strategy

What We Offer

* Hands\-on experience in a rapidly growing consumer business
* Direct exposure to the management team
* Opportunity to work with leading premium beverage brands
* Real responsibility—not just administrative work
* Performance\-based learning and growth opportunities
* Potential **full\-time employment** based on performance

How to Apply

Send your **CV/resume** along with a short introduction explaining:

**"Why do you want to work with JP Liquor Mart?"**

We are looking for people who want to **learn, build, sell, create, and grow with us.**

title: Business Development Intern – MBA Marketing Fresher | Field Outreach & Demo Scheduling
description:
Business Development Intern – MBA Marketing Preferred \- Field Outreach, Lead Generation and Demo Scheduling

**Location:** Guwahati, Assam  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 3 months initially, with possibility of extension or conversion based on performance  
**Preferred Qualification:** MBA Marketing student / MBA Marketing fresher  
**Work Mode:** Market visits, field outreach, online research and office coordination

Job Summary

We are looking for a curious, confident, and growth\-oriented **Business Development Intern** to support B2B lead generation, prospect identification, first\-level qualification, and demo scheduling for a workforce technology platform.

This internship is best suited for an **MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher** who wants practical exposure to real business development, market visits, customer conversations, consultative selling, and pipeline building.

The selected intern will be expected to identify and visit potential prospects in Guwahati and nearby business areas, find the right decision\-makers, understand their basic workforce\-related challenges, keep prospects warm through follow\-ups, and schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.

The intern’s primary role will be to open conversations, identify genuine opportunities, keep prospects warm, and schedule demos. Product demonstrations, commercial discussions, and final closures will be handled by the business owner/founder after the opportunity is qualified.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and research potential organizations across selected industries such as manufacturing, education, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, trading, distribution, and growing businesses.
* Visit potential prospects in Guwahati and nearby business areas to identify the right contact person and understand the organization’s basic requirements.
* Build and maintain a structured lead database with company details, industry, location, decision\-maker information, contact details, workforce size, outreach status, and follow\-up notes.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers such as founders, owners, HR managers, operations heads, administrators, school management, hospital administrators, and business heads.
* Conduct first\-level outreach through market visits, phone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp where appropriate.
* Briefly introduce the platform and understand whether the organization has relevant workforce\-management needs.
* Ask basic discovery questions related to attendance, leave management, employee communication, hiring, training, task visibility, employee engagement, and workforce coordination.
* Qualify prospects based on relevance, need, interest level, decision\-maker access, and willingness to explore a discussion.
* Schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.
* Keep prospects warm through disciplined follow\-ups and regular communication.
* Maintain daily updates and weekly reports on prospects visited, leads researched, conversations held, qualified opportunities, demos scheduled, and next steps.

Required Skills

* MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher preferred.
* Good communication skills in English, Hindi, and preferably Assamese.
* Comfortable with field visits, market outreach, and meeting new people.
* Confidence to speak with business owners, HR professionals, administrators, operations leaders, and decision\-makers.
* Basic understanding of internet research, LinkedIn, email communication, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Ability to listen carefully, ask relevant questions, and document prospect responses clearly.
* Good follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Curiosity to understand business problems and customer needs.
* Willingness to learn about B2B sales, workforce technology, HR tech, and consultative selling.

Mindset We Are Looking For

We are not looking for a routine telecaller.

We are looking for someone who is curious, sincere, and hungry to learn business development from the ground up.

This opportunity is best suited for a person who wants to understand how real sales pipelines are built through market research, physical visits, customer conversations, follow\-ups, relationship building, and consistent effort.

The ideal candidate should have:

* Hunger to learn and grow professionally.
* Willingness to go to the market and meet prospects.
* Curiosity to understand how businesses work.
* Confidence to speak with new people and ask thoughtful questions.
* Persistence to follow up without losing discipline.
* Ownership to complete tasks properly and maintain accurate records.
* Patience to understand that B2B solution selling takes time.
* Ability to keep prospects warm and stay connected professionally.
* Openness to feedback and improvement.
* Interest in building a long\-term career in sales, marketing, business development, consulting, or client\-facing roles.

Note: This is not about selling a simple product. This is about learning how to identify business opportunities, understand customer problems, build trust, and create a qualified sales pipeline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher.
* Strong interest in sales, marketing, business development, B2B sales, or client\-facing roles.
* Comfortable with market visits and first\-level customer interaction.
* Interested in consultative selling rather than only calling or sending messages.
* Organized in maintaining lead data, reports, and follow\-ups.
* Able to identify genuine opportunities rather than simply collecting contact details.
* Familiarity with Guwahati’s local business areas and commercial ecosystem will be an advantage.
* Willing to learn, improve, and grow into a larger business development role over time.

What You Will Learn

* How to identify potential B2B opportunities in Guwahati and nearby markets.
* How to research and profile organizations.
* How to find and approach decision\-makers.
* How to conduct first\-level discovery conversations.
* How to qualify leads before a product demo.
* How to build and maintain a sales pipeline.
* How to keep prospects warm through follow\-ups.
* How consultative selling differs from regular telecalling.
* How workforce technology and HR tech platforms are positioned to businesses.
* How real business development works from the ground level.

Performance Expectations

The intern will be expected to:

* Visit selected prospects in the market.
* Build a clean and relevant prospect database.
* Identify suitable decision\-makers.
* Conduct professional first\-level outreach.
* Generate meaningful conversations.
* Schedule qualified product demos or introductory meetings.
* Maintain accurate records and follow\-up notes.
* Show improvement in communication, confidence, and business understanding over time.

Stipend and Incentives

A fixed internship stipend may be provided, along with performance\-based incentives for qualified demos or meetings scheduled.

Compensation will depend on the candidate’s commitment, communication ability, quality of work, field effort, and ability to generate qualified business opportunities.

Growth Opportunity

This internship may lead to a longer\-term role based on performance, maturity, ownership, communication skills, field discipline, and ability to generate qualified opportunities.

High\-performing interns may be considered for future roles such as:

* Business Development Associate
* Lead Generation Associate
* Inside Sales Associate
* Client Relationship Executive
* Product Sales Consultant

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Guwahati, Assam (Guwahati, Kamrup District)

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Product Manager will drive product development and manage the entire product life cycle for CallHippo's VoIP telephony platform, with a strong emphasis on using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and similar) to accelerate market research, competitor analysis, and requirement definition. This role requires a strategic thinker who can combine product management fundamentals with hands\-on AI fluency to make faster, better\-informed decisions.
   

  

 Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive product development from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) to conduct market research, synthesize customer needs, and surface emerging trends in VoIP, telephony, and SaaS communication.
* Perform structured competitor analysis with AI assistance — benchmarking features, pricing, positioning, and messaging — before defining product requirements.
* Draft, refine, and pressure\-test product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and specs using AI, while applying human judgment to validate output.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps, ensuring timely delivery of features.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to define product specifications.
* Use AI to analyze user feedback, support tickets, and product usage data at scale to identify pain points and opportunities.
* Manage product pricing and positioning strategies to maximize market share and profitability.
* Oversee product testing and QA processes to ensure product excellence.
* Monitor product performance and continuously feed insights back into the roadmap.
* Build and document repeatable AI\-assisted workflows and prompt templates the wider team can reuse.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* 4\-7 years of experience in product management or a related field.
* Proven track record of driving product development and managing the product life cycle.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) for research, analysis, writing, or workflow automation.
* Strong knowledge of product planning, testing, and delivery management.

title: Talent Acquisition Internship in Mumbai
description:
Designation: Talent acquisition intern
   

  

 Company: Scale 100X.ai by Expertrons
   

  

 Location: Andheri East
   

  

 Internship tenure: 6\-month internship \+ PPO guaranteed on performance
   

  

 Scale100x.ai: We are the world’s first AI\-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner\-led expansion. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni and serial entrepreneurs behind Expertrons, the team has built and exited ventures to public\-listed companies and scaled 300\+ franchise networks across sectors. We support high\-potential brands by building 100\+ outlets or partners annually, leveraging AI\-driven sales, marketing, and operational execution, driving profitability through data\-led processes, assisting with fundraising, investor relations, and IPO preparedness, and providing a proprietary AI\-based scalability score to guide long\-term growth. In the last year, we’ve driven growth across EV, F\&B, Retail, Salon, EdTech, Play Areas, and more\- including enabling a partner brand to raise $5\.4M in Series A. We are now expanding our team to build the next generation of high\-growth consumer brands in India and globally. If you want to work at the intersection of AI, growth, franchising, and venture building, Scale100x.ai is the place to be.
   

  

 This internship is a career\-launchpad for individuals who want to build a strong foundation in talent acquisition. You will gain end\-to\-end exposure to sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordination, and hiring strategy while working closely with senior HR leaders. We are looking for highly motivated MBA freshers and fresh graduates who wish to kickstart their career in the talent acquisition domain with structured learning, strong mentorship, and a clear path toward career advancement. After 6 months, a pre\-placement offer (PPO) will be extended based on consistent performance, ownership, and onboarding numbers.
   

  

**Selected Intern's Day\-to\-day Responsibilities Include**
* Talent sourcing \& pipeline development:
* Source talent through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals \& internal databases.
* Build a strong, high\-quality candidate pipeline across multiple functions, with a special focus on sales hiring.
* Screening \& shortlisting:
* Review resumes and conduct initial telephonic screenings.
* Evaluate candidates based on job criteria.
* Follow up consistently to reduce drop\-offs and improve joining rates.
* Coordination \& candidate experience:
* Schedule interviews with hiring managers.
* Maintain professional, timely candidate communications.
* Onboarding \& documentation:
* Coordinate offer rollouts \& joining formalities with HR operations.
* Internal reporting:
* Maintain accurate daily/weekly hiring trackers.
* Share recruitment insights \& performance reports.


**Your Growth Path**
* Your growth here is simple: the more smoothly you manage the hiring process and support successful onboardings, the faster you grow.
* Weeks 1–2: Getting started: You quickly settle into our processes, begin sourcing for active roles, and support candidates through the early stages of the funnel\- contributing to onboarding readiness from the start
* Months 1–2: Building confidence: You start handling roles more independently, coordinating interviews, maintaining pipelines, and assisting candidates through to offer and joining.
* Months 3–4: Taking steady ownership: You manage multiple roles comfortably, maintain consistent communication with selected candidates, and help ensure smooth, timely onboardings.
* Months 5–6: Full flow \& PPO evaluation: You handle end\-to\-end hiring with confidence, support predictable onboarding cycles, and demonstrate consistency\- leading to your performance\-based PPO.
* The PPO serves as a transition into a full\-time role where you continue to grow within talent acquisition or explore adjacent HR verticals, depending on your interest. The more value you add and the more dependable you become in the onboarding process, the stronger your PPO pathway becomes.


 Kickstart your talent acquisition career, make a real impact from day one, and secure your PPO by driving successful onboarding! Interested candidates can fill out the form below so that we can connect with you.
   

  

 About Company: Expertrons is one of the world's largest AI video bot\-assisted platforms, focusing on providing a career transformation journey. It is led by IITB alumni and second\-time ed\-tech entrepreneurs, Jatin Solanki (previously founded StepApp \& EduIsFun) and Vivek Gupta (whose previous venture was acquired by a publicly listed company). Through this platform, we are connecting job\-seeking aspirants with Industry leaders, aka experts, helping them gain career insights, to settle their careers in their desired domains, from elite experts. Recently, Expertrons raised a funding of $2\.3 million in the pre\-series round, witnessing investors like Yoga Capital, Venture Catalysts, Auxano Capital, and existing investors, LetsVenture, Ivycap Ventures, Iceland Venture Studios, Nikhil Vora (MD, Sixth Sense), and more.

We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. Operations Manager – U.S. Business Operations

**Salary:** ₹8–12 LPA, depending on experience

Offered Employee Benefits \& Perks

✅ Paid Annual Leave \& Public Holidays  
✅ Comprehensive Health Insurance
