title: Cloud Application Support Engineer (APAC) - Noida
description:
**Our Context**
 NeoXam is a growing international financial software company headquartered in Paris, with a strong and expanding presence across India. Through our combined expertise and transparent approach, we help Buy\-Side and Sell\-Side organizations \- across banking, asset management, and insurance \- navigate the continuous changes shaping the financial industry. Our solutions span the complete financial value chain, from centralized data management to front\- and back\-office software.
   

  

 With 750\+ dedicated staff across 21 offices worldwide \- including Sydney, Melbourne, New York, Boston, Paris, Frankfurt, Luxembourg, Zurich, Geneva, Milan, London, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, Noida, Chennai, and more \- NeoXam combines global scale with an entrepreneurial, collaborative culture. More than 150 clients across the globe trust NeoXam to run their most critical workflows.
   

  

 As part of our expanding NeoXam as a Service (NXaaS) operating model, we are looking for a motivated and technically strong
 **Technical Support \& Cloud Consultant** 
 to join our Indian team. This is a hands\-on role that blends client\-facing support with cloud infrastructure ownership, making it ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of financial software and modern cloud operations. As we continue to grow our global SaaS footprint, this role will evolve alongside increasing monitoring, observability, and operational responsibilities. NXaaS operates a follow\-the\-sun support model across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas \- this role covers Indian business hours.
   

  

 You will support NeoXam's core product suite, including:
   

  

* NeoXam DataHub – a centralized data management platform purpose\-built for financial institutions, serving as a hub for all data consumed or produced across the enterprise.
* NeoXam IBOR – a uniquely independent and flexible Investment Book of Record, providing asset managers with a single, continuously updated source for positions, valuations, and forecasts across multiple views.
* NeoXam Aro – an intelligent, low\-code reconciliation and data lifecycle platform that transforms fragmented, manual processes into a unified, AI\-powered solution.
* NeoXam Impress – an end\-to\-end solution for client, digital, and regulatory reporting, covering data integration, performance calculations, production workflows, and data visualization.


**Your Missions**
 Serve as the first technical point of contact for NeoXam's global clients, covering Australian business hours within NeoXam's follow\-the\-sun support model and ensuring seamless handoff with APAC and EMEA counterparts.
   

  

* Triage, analyze, and own support tickets end\-to\-end \- from anomaly identification and root cause investigation through to resolution, including software\-level fixes in Java and escalation to R\&D when required.
* Review and respond to monitoring alerts and operational dashboards, identifying and acting on anomalies before they impact clients; monitor and manage cloud resources (primarily AWS) to ensure performance and availability against production SLAs.
* Troubleshoot and enhance cloud\-based deployments; implement patches and configuration fixes; support data migration and cloud onboarding initiatives in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
* Manage technical installations, upgrades, and environment refreshes for client\-facing deployments; maintain internal environment replicas for issue reproduction and testing.
* Collaborate with the Paris R\&D team and global support counterparts to resolve complex issues and contribute to the NXaaS knowledge base.
* Support pre\-sales and implementation teams on technical matters; participate in client calls, project updates, and cross\-team coordination.


**Your Profile**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of experience in technical support, implementation, or infrastructure roles within financial software or the banking/financial services industry.
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM); AWS certification is a plus.
* Proficient in Java application troubleshooting \- log analysis, memory management, thread dumps, and configuration.
* Ability to diagnose and interpret common database performance issues \- including slow queries, missing indexes, lock contention, and execution plan analysis. Experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL query tuning is strongly preferred.
* Experience with relational databases \- Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
* Scripting ability (Shell, Python, or equivalent) for automation and diagnostics.
* Familiarity with web application servers (Tomcat, JBoss, or WebSphere) and messaging systems (IBM MQ, Kafka, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of XML, REST/SOAP web services, and API integrations.
* EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service): Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience with Amazon EKS for container orchestration from support perspective.
* Monitoring \& Observability Tools: Hands\-on experience with solutions such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar platforms for system monitoring, logging, and performance visualization.
* Familiarity with Git and standard version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux/Unix environments and command\-line operations.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and ITIL support practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage client relationships professionally and independently.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and collaborative — comfortable working across time zones with global teams.


**Why NeoXam**
 At NeoXam, we love people who are curious, involved, and self\-driven. We encourage creativity and strive to promote an environment and culture based on personal growth and development. We want you to express your full potential and become a major contributor to our continued growth across India and beyond.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**About the Job** 




 As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, developing, and deploying production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including LLM\-powered systems, autonomous workflows, and intelligent automation platforms that drive scalable business innovation. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists, to recognize and establish project objectives. Oversee data infrastructure maintenance, ensuring streamlined and scalable data operations. Stay updated with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and broader AI technologies, proposing their integration for operational enhancement. Effectively convey detailed data insights to non\-technical stakeholders. Uphold stringent data privacy and security protocols. Engage in the full lifecycle of AI projects, spanning from ideation through deployment and continuous upkeep.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




 \- Develop, validate, and implement Generative AI solutions and agentic AI workflows.
 



 \- Collaborate with data scientists and other stakeholders to understand and define project goals.
 



 \- Maintain data infrastructure and ensure scalability and efficiency of data\-related operations.
 



 \- Stay abreast of the latest developments in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models, and Emerging AI technologies, and recommend ways to implement them in everyday operations.
 



 \- Communicate complex data findings clearly and understandably to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \- Adhere to data privacy and security guidelines.
 



 \- Participate in the entire AI project lifecycle, from concept to deployment and maintenance.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 \- Strong grasp of computer architecture, data structures, system software, and AI fundamentals.
 



 \- Strong experience in design, build, and optimization of agentic AI workflows that enable autonomous reasoning, decision\-making, and tool interaction using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, etc.
 



 \- Strong experience in implementation and fine\-tuning Generative AI solutions (e.g., LLMs, multimodal models) for various business use cases.
 



 \- Experience with Vector databases like Qdrant, ChromaDB, Pinecone, PGVector, or similar.
 



 \- Experience in LLM integration frameworks like LlamaIndex, Ragas, etc.
 



 \- Experience with mapping NLP models (BERT and GPT) to accelerators and awareness of trade\-offs across memory, bandwidth, and compute.
 



 \- Good to have experience with ML model lifecycle management, including training, quantization, sparsity, preprocessing, and deployment.
 



 \- Proficiency in Python development in a Linux environment and using standard development tools.
 



 \- Good to have experience with deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Spark).
 



 \- Good to have working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning architectures, such as ANNs, CNNs, RNNs, and GANs, is a plus.
 



 \- Good to have experience in training, tuning, and deploying ML models for Computer Vision (e.g., ResNet), Recommendation Systems (e.g., DLRM), or related domains.
 



 \- Experience deploying AI workloads on distributed systems.
 



 \- Self\-motivated team player with a strong sense of ownership and leadership.
 



 \- Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills for effective communication and documentation.
 



 \- Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 \- Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related field.
 



 \- 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML, with a strong preference for Generative AI and Agentic AI expertise.

 *Data Eminence*

* Professional development opportunities

title: Mechatronics Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Mechatronics Engineer**
 Position
   

  

**Mechatronics Engineer**
**Experience**
**2 years**
 Location
   

  

**Bengaluru, India**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Mechatronics Engineer** 
 with approximately 2 years of experience to work on the development and integration of intelligent electro\-mechanical systems.
   

  

 The role involves a combination of
 **electronics system assembly and testing, sensors and actuators, control algorithms, estimation algorithms, embedded implementation, system configuration, and hardware\-software integration** 
 . The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across the boundary between mechanical, electrical, embedded software, and algorithms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* System Assembly \& Integration
* Assemble and integrate electro\-mechanical systems, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, controllers, and associated electronics.
* Perform wiring, connection, sensor installation, and basic electrical integration.
* Support integration of cameras, IMUs, GNSS, encoders, motors, servos, and other sensors/actuators.
* Configure systems for laboratory, ground, and flight testing.
* Troubleshoot hardware, electrical, communication, and integration issues.
* Electronics Testing \& Validation
* Develop and execute test procedures for electronic and mechatronic subsystems.
* Perform functional testing, sensor validation, actuator testing, and system\-level testing.
* Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, and logic analysers.
* Analyse test data and identify hardware, firmware, sensor, or integration issues.
* Maintain test records, test reports, and issue/defect logs.
* Control \& Estimation Algorithms
* Implement and integrate control algorithms for electro\-mechanical systems.
* Work with PID, state\-space, feedback control, actuator control, and related control techniques.
* Implement estimation algorithms such as complementary filters, Kalman filters, EKF/UKF, or sensor fusion algorithms.
* Perform sensor calibration, parameter estimation, filtering, and system identification.
* Tune control and estimation parameters based on laboratory and flight\-test data.
* Embedded Implementation
* Implement algorithms on embedded processors and real\-time computing platforms.
* Interface sensors and actuators using protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232/485, Ethernet, etc.
* Develop or modify embedded C/C\+\+ code for system integration.
* Debug hardware\-software interaction and real\-time issues.
* Support optimisation and deployment of algorithms on resource\-constrained embedded systems.
* Configuration \& Version Management
* Maintain configuration of hardware, firmware, software, sensors, and system parameters.
* Maintain configuration\-controlled parameter files, calibration data, firmware versions, and test configurations.
* Use Git or equivalent version\-control systems for software and configuration management.
* Maintain proper traceability between hardware configuration, software version, test results, and system performance.
* Support controlled release of system configurations for testing and demonstrations.
* System Testing \& Field Trials
* Participate in system\-level integration, laboratory testing, HIL/SIL testing, and field/flight trials.
* Prepare test setups and test cases based on system requirements.
* Collect and analyse telemetry, sensor, actuator, and performance data.
* Diagnose failures during integration and testing and work with the engineering team to resolve them.
* Support verification and validation activities for production\-grade systems.


**Required Skills**
* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2 years of relevant industry/project experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with electronics system assembly, integration, and testing.
* Understanding of sensors, actuators, motors, servos, and embedded systems.
* Good understanding of control systems and estimation/filtering techniques.
* Experience implementing algorithms in C/C\+\+ and/or Python.
* Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded processors, and real\-time systems.
* Working knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C and Ethernet.
* Experience using laboratory test equipment such as oscilloscopes and multimeters.
* Familiarity with Git and configuration/version management.
* Ability to read schematics, datasheets, interface specifications, and technical documentation.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to work hands\-on with hardware and participate in field/flight testing.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with UAVs, robotics, autonomous systems, gimbals, or avionics.
* Experience with IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, barometer, encoder, camera, or other navigation sensors.
* Experience with EKF/UKF, sensor fusion, visual\-inertial estimation, or inertial navigation.
* Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink.
* Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, ROS/ROS2, or similar platforms.
* Experience with HIL/SIL testing.
* Basic understanding of real\-time operating systems.
* Experience with hardware bring\-up and PCB\-level debugging.
* Familiarity with engineering standards, configuration management, and structured V\&V processes.


 Desired Attributes
   

  

* Hands\-on engineer who enjoys working with both hardware and software.
* Comfortable moving between mechanical assembly, electronics, algorithms, and embedded implementation.
* Strong debugging mindset with an ability to systematically isolate problems.
* Good understanding of engineering fundamentals rather than dependence on pre\-built libraries or tools.
* Able to work independently on assigned modules while collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced R\&D environment involving prototyping, testing, iteration, and field trials.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.


 Typical Technology Environment
   

  

**Sensors \& Actuators:** 
 IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, encoders, cameras, motors, servos
   

  

**Embedded:** 
 Microcontrollers, ARM processors, embedded Linux/RTOS
   

  

**Algorithms:** 
 PID, state estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, system identification
   

  

**Programming:** 
 C/C\+\+, Python, MATLAB/Simulink
   

  

**Testing:** 
 Oscilloscope, logic analyser, multimeter, power supply, HIL/SIL
   

  

 This is a
 **hands\-on R\&D engineering role** 
 suited for an engineer who wants to work on complete intelligent systems rather than a narrowly defined mechanical or electronics function. The engineer will contribute across
 **assembly → integration → algorithm implementation → configuration → testing → debugging → field validation** 
 , with particular emphasis on UAV and autonomous\-system applications.
   

  

 Skills:\- Electronics, Digital electronics, PCB, PID, UART, SPI, C\+\+, Git, Robotics and ARM Microcontroller

title: Lab Assistant
description:
Lab AssistantFabrication, Test \& Lab Support
 
 TeleBortiX is building state\-of\-the\-art airborne systems.
 



 You will be the hands that keep the lab moving. This is a shared role — you support every team in the shop: aerodynamics, structures, design, and production. One day that's helping lay up a composite part; the next it's setting up a test rig, tending the print farm, or making sure the shelves are stocked and the logs are current. It's an early\-career role built for someone hands\-on, careful, and hungry — you'll pick up composites, machining, 3D printing, and test work on real airborne hardware, and grow into a specialist as we scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * **Fabrication support:** 
 assist composite builds — prep moulds, cut and kit plies, mix resin, help with layup, bagging, and demoulding, then trimming and finishing.
* **Print farm:** 
 load, monitor, and change material on the 3D printers, and post\-process the parts.
* **Machining \& bench:** 
 workholding help, deburring, and finishing, and keeping machines and benches clean and maintained.
* **Test support:** 
 help the aero and structures teams set up and run bench and rig tests — mount specimens, wire up basic instrumentation, and log data.
* **Inventory \& consumables:** 
 keep raw stock and consumables stocked and logged, receive deliveries, flag low stock, and pull kits and BOMs for builds.
* **Records:** 
 maintain the logs that matter — material lot and out\-time records, cure logs, and job travelers — accurately, and without being chased.
* **Housekeeping \& safety:** 
 keep the lab clean, organised, and safe — PPE, waste handling, and following process every time.
* **General support:** 
 be the reliable pair of hands any team in the lab can call on.


 Requirements
 
 Candidates should meet
 **three of the five** 
 criteria below to apply.
 


* Hands\-on aptitude — you've built, fixed, or made things, whether at work, in school, or as a hobby.
* Some exposure to any of: composites, machining, 3D printing, electronics/test, or general fabrication.
* Careful, methodical, and organised — you understand that logs and inventory only work if they're done right.
* Comfortable with shop safety and following a process exactly.
* Genuinely eager to learn the craft and grow.



*Note: We welcome recent graduates, ITI / diploma holders, and self\-taught makers. If you're short on formal experience but clearly hands\-on and hungry, make the case in your application note.* 



 Strongly preferred
 * Any composites, 3D\-printing, or machine\-shop experience — school, internship, or personal.
* Comfort with hand and power tools.
* Basic electronics — wiring, soldering, sensors — useful for test\-rig support.
* A personal building habit: drones, RC, robotics, motorsport, or maker projects.
* Basic measurement skills (calipers, gauges).
* First\-aid or shop\-safety awareness.


 Org Structure
 
 You will report directly to the Director, Engineering, and support the whole lab — aerodynamics, structures, design, and production alike. This is a shared role: you work for everyone in the shop.
 


 About TeleBortiX
 
 We build state\-of\-the\-art airborne systems. Our engineering team is small and multi\-skilled. We hire for skills, not for job titles — and we invest in people who are hungry to learn.
 


 Location, compensation, and how to apply
 * **Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 **Compensation:** 
 Commensurate with experience; equity component negotiable.
 **To apply:** 
 Send your CV and a short note on something you've built or made — what it was, and what you learned making it.

**About Airblack \& Zudo**




  





 Airblack is India’s largest alternate skilling platform. Our mission is to help the next 100 million people in the workforce get access to meaningful opportunities. With a lean team of under 30 people working at the intersection of
 **AI and learning** 
 ,
 
 we are on track to cross 100cr in revenue run\-rate in FY27\.
 



  





 We currently operate in sectors such as content creation, SME skills, beauty, fashion, nutrition, digital \& home businesses, impacting over 1M learners every month. Our apps consistently rank in top 10 education apps in India with 1M\+ users and 40M\+ minutes of learning content being consumed every month. One of our new products, Zudo, is now India’s fastest growing apps in the skilling / content space.
 



  





 Airblack has raised Rs. 100cr\+ from marquee investors such as Elevation Capital, Info Edge Ventures, Michael \& Susan Dell Foundation, Blume Founders Fund and Better Capital, and leading angels such as Vidit (Meesho), Kunal (CRED), Deepinder (Zomato), Harshit \& Shashank (Razorpay) and so on.
 



  





**What would you be doing?**




  





**Role** 




 Own the product roadmap for a rocketship growing 100% MoM. We're at 1M MAU and need to hit 10M in 12 months without breaking things.
 



  




* **AI\-powered product strategy:** 
 Define and ship AI\-first features such as \- personalized learning paths, smart recommendations, conversational tutors and automated assessments.
* **Drive hyper\-growth metrics:** 
 Own user growth and engagement. Drive improvements in user retention across all time horizons. Optimize free\-to\-paid conversion. Reduce customer acquisition costs through product\-led growth while increasing lifetime value.
* **Run experiments at scale:** 
 Ship experiments across onboarding, discovery, engagement and monetization. Build a robust testing framework for rapid prototyping and testing.
* **Scale the platform:** 
 Build creator tools and AI\-assisted content workflows to 10x content velocity. Design marketplace dynamics \- matching algorithms, quality scoring, discovery, creator incentives. Expand to 30\+ categories. Create features that improve with scale (network effects, data moats, content flywheel).
* **Lead cross\-functional teams:** 
 Work directly with founders on strategy and OKRs. Lead pods of 8\-10 people across engineering, design, analytics, growth, content. Establish product culture: user obsession, bias for speed, data\-driven decisions, extreme ownership.



  





**Perks** 



* **Fast\-growth:** 
 This role fast\-tracks to VP \-\> CXO in 2\-3 years
* **High skin in the game:** 
 Aggressive ESOP allocations at the onset. We recently concluded our first ESOP buyback, and if the company continues doing well in next 3 years, this promises to be a life\-altering opportunity in terms on ESOP liquidity
* **Build in one of the highest talent density in consumer\-tech:** 
 Learn from and work with some of the best peers you can find in a consumer\-tech company in NCR.
* **Infinite budget for knowledge, upskilling, tech tools \& AI tools**
* **Mentor connect** 
 available to the whose and whose of startup ecosystem (check our angel investor list)
* **Usuals** 
 : Health Insurance cover, flexible leave policy, a free environment to build what you love



  





**What makes you a suitable candidate?**




  





 We are assembling some of the smartest and highly ambitious individuals under one roof, to build a consumer\-tech company that we can be proud of. This will not be a 9\-5 well defined role, so if you're looking for one, you shouldn't consider applying.
 



  





**Core background:** 




  




* 4\-10 years in product, with 3\+ years at high\-growth consumer startups (spaces such as consumer AI, edtech, social/content, travel, fintech, marketplace preferred)
* Proven 0→1 and 1→100 experience \- shipped products from scratch and scaled to millions
* Track record of impact with numbers: "increased retention by 35%", "drove $2M ARR",
* Built and shipped AI/ML features (recommendations, personalization, NLP, LLM applications)
* Have done cross\-functional execution in the past: aligned eng, design, growth, content around shared goals
* Strong preference for
 **ex\-entrepreneurs or ex\-software engineers or data analysts** 
 looking to transition to product. Strong preference for Tier\-1 education background.
* Deep understanding of Tier 2/3 India users (lived experience or strong empathy)



  





**Expertise:** 




  




* You identify as
 **AI native.** 
 You dont need a dev team to ship the first prototype / design of a feature or a product, or a data team to ship a dashboard
* Can understand system architecture, and discuss technical trade\-offs with engineers
* Strong data skills \- write SQL, analyze data, understand statistics and A/B testing
* Expert in analytics tools (Mixpanel/Amplitude), SQL, experimentation platforms
* Deep understanding of unit economics, LTV:CAC, payback periods
* Mobile\-first DNA with iOS/Android expertise

 At Amazon, we are always exploring new opportunities to shape our global business. As a Program Manager I, you will play a key role in executing and improving programs that drive operational excellence. You will support the design and rollout of new initiatives, while owning the day\-to\-day management of existing programs. This role is designed for individuals who thrive in structured environments and are building strong program management fundamentals.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to have a meaningful impact on some of the most exciting initiatives that are shaping the future of Amazon.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Execute defined programs and support launches within a structured scope
   

  

 Track performance metrics and provide updates on program deliverables
   

  

 Use data to identify operational gaps and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement solutions and best practices
   

  

 Coordinate tasks, manage dependencies, and escalate risks when needed
   

  

 Support process standardization and documentation to improve scalability and consistency
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Program Manager I, your day will focus on execution and coordination. You will manage defined projects, track progress against goals, and ensure timely delivery of tasks.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with stakeholders across teams to understand requirements, resolve blockers, and maintain visibility on program health. While you may seek guidance for complex decisions, you are expected to independently manage day\-to\-day execution.
   

  

 You’ll also use data to identify trends, support improvements to existing processes, and ensure that deliverables align with team goals and metrics. Your work will contribute directly to the reliability and efficiency of operations.

 Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) plays a central role in ensuring efficient and reliable delivery across the network. As part of ATS, you’ll work with a diverse team focused on optimizing transportation across air, sea, and road networks using advanced technology and data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 The team prioritizes safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. By leveraging data and collaboration, ATS ensures packages are delivered quickly, efficiently, and sustainably while maintaining high standards of reliability.

**We are looking for** 
**System Engineering Project Manager – Rolling stock**
**You’ll make a difference by**
 The System Engineering Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful delivery of complex system engineering projects. They will oversee the planning, execution, and control of project activities, ensuring that technical requirements, budgets, and timelines are met. The System Engineering Project Manager will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including system engineers, software developers, and stakeholders, to coordinate and optimize project performance.
   

  

* Define the project scope, objectives, and technical requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Develop a comprehensive project plan, including schedules, resource allocation, and milestones.

* Develop and maintain a detailed project schedule, identifying critical paths and dependencies.
* Monitor and control the project budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Implement effective cost\-control measures and report on project KPI’s.
* Identify, analyze, and proactively manage potential technical, operational, and organizational risks.
* Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to minimize the impact of identified risks.
* Continuously monitor the project environment and adjust the risk management plan as needed.
* Act as Linkage between the rolling stock business Unit and Engineering center India.
* Engage with key stakeholders, including customers, executives, and cross\-functional teams.

* Provide regular progress updates, technical reports, and presentations to stakeholders.
* Participate in global and local management meetings and present project health/KPI.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 The Senior Scrum Master plays a pivotal role in driving agile transformation within the organization. This position is responsible for facilitating effective delivery across teams, ensuring adherence to SAFe guidelines, and championing continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership abilities, a proactive approach to risk and issue management, and a proven track record in guiding complex projects to successful outcomes.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide support for 1\-2 teams with medium to high complexities and dependencies
* Proactively manage risks and issues or impediments by identifying potential impacts, target resolution dates, owners, and mitigation strategies, while ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Facilitate Scaling Agile Framework (SAFe) ceremonies and ensure adherence to SAFe guidelines to enhance team alignment and productivity. Lead Program Increment (PI) planning sessions and provide support to teams in meeting PI objectives. Oversee daily Scrum and Kanban activities, including the facilitation of stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and workflow optimization.
* Participate in prioritization activities with product owners (if available), architects and stakeholders to ensure business objectives are met.
* Supports the team in defining, refining, and ordering backlog items, ensuring they are clear and actionable.
* Helps the team adhere to the definition of done (DoD) to ensure quality and completeness
* Facilitate executive stakeholder readouts, delivering clear progress updates and insights for informed decision\-making.
* Facilitate retrospective sessions and drive continuous improvement initiatives to cultivate a culture of learning and adaptability across teams.
* Manage and coordinate dependencies across multiple teams, ensuring alignment, early identification of cross\-team risks, and streamlined delivery of integrated solutions.
* Ensure compliance with Change and Release standards and guidelines. Appropriately prioritize and plan the remediation of production defects, incidents, and problem records.
* Ensure adherence to Enterprise EPMO standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks across all assigned Agile teams, aligning delivery practices with organizational expectations and controls.
* Track, report, and continuously improve against Enterprise EPMO governance metrics, including delivery health, predictability, risk, dependency management, and compliance indicators.
* Partner with the Enterprise EPMO, Release Train Engineers, and Program Leadership to support governance reviews, audits, and readiness checkpoints as required.
* Ensure transparency and accuracy of Agile metrics and artifacts to support Enterprise EPMO reporting, executive dashboards, and decision\-making.
* Effectively prioritize and ensure timely remediation of all identified vulnerabilities, risk findings, and audit findings in accordance with established Cyber Security SLAs, partnering with technology, security, and governance stakeholders to drive compliance and risk reduction.
* Leverage AI and automation technologies to enhance the team's productivity
* Engaged actively in LPL Agile, Planning, and EPMO communities of practice


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Scrum Master in agile environments.
* In\-depth knowledge of SAFe principles, Agile methodologies, and project management best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage risks and issues proactively in complex projects.
* Exceptional facilitation and communication skills, with experience leading PI planning and executive briefings.
* Expertise in both Scrum and Kanban frameworks.
* Proven experience managing dependencies and coordination among multiple agile teams.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAFe Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certifications.
* Experience working in large\-scale, multi\-team Agile organizations.
* Advanced degree in Business, Technology, or related discipline.
* Familiarity with agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally, or equivalent.

title: Product Coordinator
description:
Join
 *Data Eminence* 
 as a remote Product Coordinator and help support the planning, development, and delivery of our products. You'll coordinate with product, design, engineering, and business teams to keep projects organized and moving forward. Ideal for entry\-level candidates with strong organizational skills, communication abilities, and an interest in technology and product development.
 



 Full Description
 



*Data Eminence* 
 is seeking a motivated Product Coordinator to join our growing team. In this role, you will support product managers and cross\-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, helping ensure that projects stay organized, requirements are clearly communicated, and deadlines are met.
 



 You will work closely with developers, designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to track tasks, document requirements, coordinate meetings, and follow up on project deliverables. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in product management and technology\-driven projects while working remotely.
 



 Your key responsibilities will include:
 


* Supporting product managers with day\-to\-day product activities
* Coordinating tasks and timelines across product, design, and engineering teams
* Maintaining project documentation, requirements, and product specifications
* Tracking project progress and following up on pending tasks
* Organizing meetings and preparing agendas and notes
* Helping gather and document user and business requirements
* Assisting with product testing and feedback collection
* Communicating updates, blockers, and priorities to relevant stakeholders
* Supporting the preparation of product reports and presentations
* Helping identify opportunities to improve product processes and workflows



 We believe in learning by doing. You'll work alongside experienced product and technology professionals and gain exposure to product planning, Agile methodologies, user research, project management tools, and software development workflows.
 



 This is a hands\-on role where organization, communication, attention to detail, and proactive problem\-solving are essential. You should be comfortable managing multiple tasks, working with different teams, and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities in a remote environment.
 



 Requirements
 


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 0\-2 years of experience in product coordination, project coordination, or a relevant internship
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Basic understanding of software development and product lifecycle concepts
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, or similar platforms is beneficial
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving abilities
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment



 Benefits
 


* Competitive salary
* Fully remote work flexibility
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities
* Company\-provided equipment

 User Experience

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 At Salesforce, our global Product UX teams aspire to make tools that make a salesperson's day more productive, a marketer's campaign more powerful, or a developer's app more feature\-rich. Our UX designers craft Salesforce's enterprise and consumer products; create new design patterns and guidelines for our world\-class design system; and partner with cross\-disciplinary teams to bring inclusive, accessible, and human\-centered experiences to life.
   

  

 As a Lead User Experience Designer, you will craft the product vision to build cohesive, trusted experiences that enable customer success. You will be responsible for addressing complex problems and proposing clear, efficient, and consistent solutions through individual expertise and cross\-functional influence. You will serve as a technical lead and guide fellow designers toward high\-quality outcomes, using expert design strategies to drive excellence without direct management responsibilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this role is thoughtful, curious, and open to new ways of doing things. You have excellent communication skills and can advocate for your team's work to product managers and engineers. You set an example by advocating for end users, using research insights, and encourage your team to do the same. You are fluent in working alongside AI and bring clear judgment to evaluating and shaping AI\-assisted design outputs.
   

  

 If you want to use your UX skills to inspire teams, create amazing experiences, and transform the way business gets done, we would love for you to join us!
   

  

**Experience / Skills Required**

* Serve as a bridge between design, product, engineering, and quality experts, finding opportunities for new features and validating assumptions through user testing and research, to deliver a polished final product.
* Design and maintain scalable design systems (components, patterns, standards) that support consistency across product surfaces.
* Partner with engineering to define how AI agents surface in product workflows, informing when and how agent\-driven interactions appear to users.
* Promote and educate others on interface guidelines and design patterns to extend the existing style guides and design system.
* Deliver software that is inclusive and universal, designed for users of multiple languages and abilities, adhering to WCAG and other industry standards.
* Consider how design impacts ethics and equality — including responsible AI — and speaks up if veering off course.

description:
Junior Graphic Designer
 



  





**About Creative Pulp Design** 




**Creative Pulp Design (CPD)** 
 is a founder\-led branding and communication design studio rooted in India, working at the intersection of
 **strategy, narrative and design** 
 .
 



  





 We partner with organisations to build clear, consistent and meaningful brands — from visual identities and communication systems to digital platforms, campaigns and long\-form publications.
 



  





 We’re a small, hands\-on, founder\-led studio, which means you’ll work closely with the person shaping the brief, the thinking and the final work — rather than being one person in a large production pipeline.
 



 We value
 **clarity over clutter, thinking over templates, and good design that solves a real communication problem.** 




  





  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a
 **Junior Graphic Designer** 
 who loves making things look good
 *and* 
 thinks about why they work.
 



  





 You’ll work directly with the founder and lead designer across a mix of branding and communication projects. This isn’t just about taking a brief and making it pretty — we want you to understand the idea behind the brief, ask questions, and bring your own visual thinking to the work.
 



  





 You could be working on a brand identity one day, a presentation or publication the next, and digital content, campaign assets or a short motion piece after that.
 



  





 If you’re curious, detail\-obsessed, have strong design fundamentals and are always looking at how brands communicate — we’d love to see your work.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 



* Develop visual concepts and design assets across branding, digital communication, campaigns, presentations and publications.
* Translate briefs and ideas into clear, engaging visual communication.
* Work with typography, layout, grids, colour, imagery and visual hierarchy.
* Create and adapt designs across different formats and platforms.
* Support the development of brand identities, visual systems and communication guidelines.
* Work directly with the founder and lead designer, stay responsive and inquisitive to feedback, ask questions to better understand client inputs, iterate quickly, and keep pushing the work towards completion.
* Prepare artwork and final files accurately for both digital and print.
* Explore motion, animation and simple video content where relevant.
* Stay curious about new design tools, visual trends and AI\-assisted creative workflows.



  





  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **1–2 years of experience** 
 in graphic design, visual communication or a related field.

* Comfortable working across
 **Adobe Creative Suite — especially InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop and Premiere Pro** 
 .
* Basic knowledge of
 **motion graphics/animation** 
 is a strong plus.
* A portfolio that shows
 **how you think, not just what you’ve made** 
 .

* Good communication skills and the ability to receive feedback constructively and act on it.
* A willingness to collaborate, learn, experiment and take ownership of your work.
* Interest in AI\-assisted design and creative tools is a plus.
* A formal design degree is nice to have, but
 **we care more about your portfolio, design thinking and attitude than your degree.**



  





  





**Work Model** 




**Remote — open to candidates across India.** 




**If you’re based in Delhi NCR** 
 , you should be comfortable coming into the CPD studio
 **1–2 days a week when required** 
 .
 



  





  





**Probation** 




 The first

 — a chance for both you and us to see if we’re the right fit for each other.
 


* During this period, we’ll look at the quality of your work, how you collaborate, how you respond to feedback, your ownership and reliability, and how you grow with the studio.

title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software


**About The Team**
 You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.

title: Site core front end developer
description:
A Sitecore Next.js Front‑End Developer builds high‑performance, component‑driven digital experiences using Next.js, React, and Sitecore’s headless CMS (XM Cloud or JSS). * Develop reusable Next.js/React components that consume Sitecore headless content (Layout Service, GraphQL, REST).
* Integrate Sitecore JSS with Next.js including environment configuration, API setup, and editing capabilities.
* Build and maintain page layouts using Sitecore components, placeholders, and rendering structures.
* Work in disconnected and connected development modes to streamline component development.
* Optimize UI/UX performance using SSR, SSG, ISR, caching, accessibility, and responsive design best practices.
* Collaborate with designers, marketers, and backend teams to translate requirements into scalable front‑end solutions.
* Support Sitecore content teams by ensuring components are author‑friendly, flexible, and aligned with content models.

* Maintain code quality through Git workflows, code reviews, and best practices.


**Core Technical Skills**
* Next.js — SSR, SSG, ISR, routing, API routes, performance optimization
* React — hooks, state management, component architecture
* Sitecore JSS — headless integration, Layout Service, disconnected/connected mode
* Sitecore XM Cloud / XP — content modeling, components, renderings, templates
* GraphQL — querying Sitecore content via Sitecore GraphQL endpoint
* REST APIs — consuming Sitecore and external APIs
* TypeScript — strong typing, interfaces, generics
* CSS frameworks — Tailwind, SCSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components
* Node.js — build tooling, server‑side logic, package management
* Git — branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews
* Azure DevOps / CI\-CD — pipelines, deployments, environment management

* Sitecore Search / Indexing — optional but valuable

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

description:

**Job Number**

**Job Summary**
 The Director of Human Resources will report directly to the property General Manager, with a dotted\-line (functional) reporting relationship to the Regional Senior Director of Human Resources and will be an integral member of the property executive committee. As a member of the Human Resources organization, he/she contributes a high level of human resource generalist knowledge and expertise for a designated property. He/she will be accountable for talent acquisition, succession/workforce planning, performance management and development for property employees, using technology efficiently, and coaching/developing others to help influence and execute business objectives in the most efficient manner. He/she generally works with considerable independence, developing processes to accomplish objectives in alignment with broader business objectives. Additionally, he/she utilizes a Human Resource Business Plan aligned with property and brand strategies to deliver HR services that enable business success.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


 OR
   

  

* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing the Human Resources Strategy**
* Executes and follows\-up on engagement survey related activities.
* Champions and builds the talent management ranks in support of property and region diversity strategy.
* Translates business priorities into property Human Resources strategies, plans and actions
* Implements and sustains Human Resources initiatives at the property.
* Coordinates the human capital review process at property(s) and leads succession planning activities on property and in the market, as appropriate.
* Leads the assessment of property(s) leadership pipeline through the human capital review process and assists with follow\-up.
* Creates value through proactive approaches that will affect performance outcome or control cost.
* Monitors effective use of myHR by property managers and employees.
* Leads and participates in succession management and workforce planning.
* Responsible for Human Resources strategy and execution.
* Serves as key change manager for initiatives that have high employee impact.
* Attends owners meetings as a member of the property executive committee and provides meaning or context to the Human Resources results (e.g., retention statistics, critical open positions, employee satisfaction, and training initiatives and results); and demonstrates an understanding of owner priorities.
* Supervises one or more on\-property Human Resources, as well as market\-based Human Resources Specialist type resources where appropriate.


**Managing Staffing and Recruitment Process**
* Analyzes open positions to balance the development of existing talent and business needs.
* Serves as coach and expert facilitator of the selection and interviewing process.
* Surfaces opportunities in work processes and staffing optimization.
* Makes staffing decisions to manage the talent cadre and pipeline at the property.
* Develops staffing strategy (in collaboration with hiring manager) relating to hiring practices; consults with hiring manager on compensation, benefits, etc.
* Monitors sourcing process and outcomes of staffing process.
* Ensures managers are competent in assessing and evaluating hourly staff.


**Managing Employee Compensation Strategy**
* Remains current and knowledgeable in the internal and external compensation and work competitive environments.
* Leads the planning of the hourly employee total compensation strategy.
* Champions the communication and proper use of total compensation systems, tools, programs, policies, etc.
* Participates in quarterly internal equity analysis; reviews internal equity reports and surface issues needing resolution.
* Creates and implement s total compensation management packages/offers, particularly recognition and incentive programs directed towards property priorities.


**Managing Staff Development Activities**
* Ensures completion of the duties and responsibilities of the properties’ Human Resources staff members, as outlined in applicable job description(s).
* Ensures property Human Resources staff is properly trained in all employee\-related human resource information to appropriately respond to property employees.
* Serves as resource to property Human Resources staff on employee relations questions and issues.
* Continually reinforces positive employee relations concepts.

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Senior HR – Human Resources \& Talent Management

**Location:** Ranchi, Jharkhand  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years Preferred

We are looking for a **Senior HR professional** who can do much more than recruitment, attendance and payroll.

We need someone who can help us **find the right people, build a strong team, create accountability and develop a high\-performance work culture.**

As we grow, your responsibility will be simple:

**Get the right people in. Develop them. Retain the best. And build systems that allow the organization to scale.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete hiring process from **manpower planning to onboarding**
* Understand each department's actual talent requirements before starting recruitment
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, referrals and other channels
* Conduct structured interviews and candidate assessments
* Coordinate technical/departmental interview rounds
* Handle salary negotiations and offer rollouts
* Develop a strong talent pipeline for future requirements
* Improve **quality of hire**, not simply number of hires

We don't want HR to say:

**“Sir, 30 CV aa gaye hain.”**

We want HR to say:

**“I interviewed 12 candidates, shortlisted 3, and here's why these 3 fit the role.”**

2\. Performance Management

Build a performance\-driven system where every employee understands:

**What am I responsible for?**  
**How will my performance be measured?**  
**Where am I currently performing?**  
**What do I need to improve?**

Responsibilities include:

* Defining KRAs \& KPIs with department heads
* Performance reviews
* Probation evaluations
* Employee scorecards
* Performance Improvement Plans (PIP)
* Promotions and increments
* Identifying high performers and underperformers
* Creating accountability across teams

3\. Employee Development

We don't want employees doing the same job the same way for five years.

HR should help people **continuously improve.**

* Identify skill gaps
* Develop training programs
* Coordinate internal/external training
* Build leadership capabilities
* Develop future managers
* Create career\-growth paths
* Conduct regular feedback sessions

4\. Culture \& Employee Engagement

Help us build a workplace where people are:

**Ambitious. Accountable. Professional. Curious. And hungry to grow.**

Responsibilities include:

* Employee engagement
* Recognition and reward programs
* Team\-building initiatives
* Conflict resolution
* Employee feedback
* Improving communication between management and employees
* Building ownership and accountability
* Maintaining professional workplace standards

5\. HR Policies \& Systems

Create and maintain scalable HR processes for:

* Attendance
* Leave
* Working hours
* Onboarding
* Probation
* Confirmation
* Performance reviews
* Promotions
* Compensation
* Employee exits
* Full \& final settlement
* HR documentation

The objective is to make HR **system\-driven rather than person\-dependent.**

6\. HR Operations \& Compliance

* Maintain employee records and documentation
* Coordinate payroll and salary\-related information
* Maintain offer letters, appointment letters and employee files
* Manage attendance and leave records
* Handle onboarding and exit formalities
* Coordinate statutory HR compliance applicable to the organization
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information

7\. Retention \& Employee Relations

Hiring good people is difficult.

**Losing good people because nobody understood why they were leaving is worse.**

The Senior HR should:

* Conduct regular employee check\-ins
* Identify retention risks
* Conduct exit interviews
* Understand reasons behind attrition
* Resolve workplace concerns professionally
* Recommend retention strategies to management

8\. Management Partnership

This is a **Senior HR role**, not simply an administrative HR position.

You should be comfortable working directly with management on:

* Workforce planning
* Organizational structure
* Hiring priorities
* Salary benchmarking
* Performance issues
* Promotions
* Leadership development
* Employee retention
* Culture
* HR budgeting
* Future manpower requirements

You should be capable of challenging management respectfully when you believe a **people decision could hurt the organization.**

Qualification

Preferred:

**MBA / PGDM in HR**  
or  
**Master's/Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Management or related field**

Professional HR certifications will be an added advantage.

However, **practical HR leadership experience and demonstrated results will carry significant weight.**

Experience

**5\+ years of HR experience preferred**, with meaningful exposure to:

* Recruitment
* Performance management
* Employee relations
* HR operations
* Policies \& compliance
* Team building
* Talent development

Previous experience building or improving HR systems in a **growing company** will be highly valued.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone who combines:

**People Skills \+ Business Understanding \+ Discipline \+ Empathy \+ Data \+ Leadership**

Someone who can have a friendly conversation with an employee in the morning and conduct a difficult performance conversation professionally in the afternoon.

Someone who understands that HR's responsibility isn't simply to keep employees happy.

It's to create an environment where **good people can perform exceptionally well and the organization can grow.**

How to Apply

Please send:

* Updated CV
* Current location
* Current/Last organization
* Total HR experience
* Current/Last salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period
* One example of an HR system/process you personally built or significantly improved

**Work Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand**

What Success Looks Like in This Role

After joining, we should gradually see:

**Better Hiring → Better Onboarding → Clearer Accountability → Better Performance → Stronger Managers → Lower Unwanted Attrition → Stronger Culture**

We are looking for someone who can help us **build the organization, not simply run the HR department.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Future Frame Consultants (FFC) is looking for a **local HR professional based in Latur** to work as an **On\-Ground HR Consultant / FFC Coordinator** for one of our client assignments.

The selected candidate will act as the **local representative of FFC at the client location** and will be responsible for coordinating between FFC’s consulting team and the client’s management and employees.

This is an execution\-oriented HR role involving **HR process implementation, employee coordination, SOP implementation, reporting, follow\-ups and client coordination**.

Key Responsibilities1\. FFC – Client Coordination

* Act as the primary on\-ground coordinator between FFC and the client.
* Coordinate with the FFC consulting team on implementation activities.
* Understand FFC’s recommendations and support their implementation at the client location.
* Maintain regular communication with the FFC team regarding progress, challenges and pending actions.
* Follow up with the client team on agreed action points.

2\. HR Process Implementation

* Assist in implementing HR systems, processes and policies recommended by FFC.
* Support attendance, leave and employee documentation processes.
* Maintain and update employee master data.
* Assist with manpower planning and recruitment coordination.
* Support employee onboarding and joining formalities.
* Assist in performance management and employee evaluation processes.

3\. SOP \& Process Implementation

* Assist the FFC team in implementing HR and business SOPs.
* Observe existing practices and identify process gaps.
* Follow up with managers and employees regarding SOP adherence.
* Maintain implementation trackers and checklists.
* Report deviations and recurring issues to the FFC consultant.

4\. Employee Coordination \& Engagement

* Act as a point of contact for routine HR\-related employee matters.
* Coordinate employee meetings, feedback sessions and training programs.
* Assist in identifying employee concerns and workplace issues.
* Support employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives.
* Maintain professional communication with employees at all levels.

5\. MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare regular HR and implementation reports.
* Maintain recruitment, attendance, manpower, training and performance trackers.
* Collect required information and data from the client.
* Share accurate and timely reports with the FFC consulting team.
* Maintain proper documentation of implementation activities.

6\. Recruitment \& Training Coordination

* Coordinate recruitment requirements with the FFC team.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates.
* Support onboarding and joining processes.
* Coordinate training programs conducted by FFC.
* Maintain training attendance, feedback and assessment records.
* Follow up on post\-training implementation.

7\. On\-Ground Observation \& Support

The candidate should be comfortable working **on the client’s premises and interacting directly with employees and managers**.

Responsibilities will include:

* Observing employee behaviour, discipline and workplace practices.
* Identifying people and process gaps.
* Monitoring adherence to defined processes.
* Coordinating with managers and department heads.
* Supporting FFC in collecting information required for consulting assignments.
* Providing regular on\-ground feedback to the FFC team.

Candidate Profile

**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Candidate must be **based in Latur**.
* **MBA / PGDM in Human Resources is mandatory.**
* Minimum **2 years of relevant HR experience**.
* Strong understanding of HR processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good command of **English, Hindi and Marathi**.
* Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and basic MIS.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Comfortable interacting with business owners, managers and employees.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* HR Consulting
* HR Generalist
* Retail HR
* Employee Engagement
* Recruitment \& Onboarding
* SOP Implementation
* Performance Management
* Training Coordination
* Store/Business Operations

What We Are Looking For

This is **not a purely desk\-based HR position**.

We are looking for someone who can:

**Understand → Coordinate → Implement → Follow Up → Report → Escalate**

The candidate should have the maturity to represent FFC professionally at the client location and work effectively with both management and employees.

Key Competencies

* HR Process Knowledge
* Communication Skills
* Stakeholder Management
* Follow\-up \& Execution
* Problem Solving
* Documentation \& Reporting
* Employee Handling
* Process Orientation
* Professionalism
* Ownership \& Accountability

Performance Measures

The role will be evaluated on:

* Timely implementation of assigned HR processes.
* Accuracy and timeliness of reports.
* Completion and follow\-up of assigned action points.
* Effective coordination between FFC and the client.
* HR documentation and process compliance.
* Identification and reporting of people/process gaps.
* Recruitment and training coordination.
* Quality of on\-ground observations and reporting.
* Professional handling of employees and client stakeholders.
* Overall support provided to FFC in successful execution of the client assignment.

**Latur\-based candidates will be strongly preferred.**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled HR Manager with **4\-5 years of experience** in payroll operations, **hiring**, **recruitment**, **strategic talent management**, and **performance management**. The ideal candidate should hold a **Master’s degree in Human Resources** or possess significant relevant HR experience, particularly within the **Health Care industry**. This multifaceted role requires expertise in payroll management, employee recruitment, compensation and benefits, talent development, employee retention strategies, and effective event planning. Knowledge of **performance management appraisal systems** and experience with **GreytHR software** are key to success in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Payroll Management:** Oversee and manage the full payroll cycle, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely disbursements. Handle deductions, bonuses, overtime, and statutory benefits in line with company policies.
* **Compliance \& Reporting:** Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations regarding payroll, compensation, and employee benefits. Prepare regular payroll and tax reports for internal stakeholders and government filing.
* **Hiring and Recruitment:** Lead the recruitment process by creating compelling job descriptions, posting positions, sourcing talent, and conducting interviews. Collaborate with hiring managers to ensure recruitment strategies align with the company’s talent needs.
* **Job Descriptions:** Develop detailed and compelling job descriptions to attract top talent. Collaborate with department heads to ensure job descriptions are aligned with organizational needs and expectations.
* **Onboarding \& Training:** Design and implement effective onboarding and training programs to ensure new hires are well\-integrated and equipped for success. Ensure the company culture is effectively communicated and upheld.
* **Strategic Talent Management:** Develop and execute strategies for identifying, developing, and retaining top talent. Implement succession planning and leadership development programs to build a strong talent pipeline for the future.
* **Employee Retention Strategies:** Work to increase employee engagement and retention through targeted programs such as performance management, career development opportunities, and feedback mechanisms.
* **Compensation and Benefits Management:** Administer employee compensation structures, benefits programs, and ensure they are competitive within the market. Conduct compensation reviews and ensure alignment with company policies and industry standards.
* **Performance Management Appraisal System:** Oversee and enhance the **performance management appraisal system** to ensure regular performance reviews, feedback, and goal\-setting for employees. Drive improvements in employee performance and align individual goals with company objectives.
* **Event Planning \& Scheduling:** Streamline event planning and scheduling for company\-wide events such as team\-building activities, employee recognition programs, and other HR\-driven initiatives.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with leadership teams and other HR functions to integrate recruitment, payroll, and talent management efforts. Maintain open lines of communication across departments to support organizational goals.

**Skills \& Qualifications:**

* **HR experience in Health Care**: Minimum of **4 years of HR experience** in the healthcare industry is **required**.
* **Master’s degree in Human Resources**, Business Administration, or related field, OR equivalent professional HR experience (4\-5 years).
* **4\-5 years of HR experience**, particularly in payroll management, hiring/recruitment, talent management, employee retention, and **performance management**.
* Expertise in **payroll software**, HRIS systems, and recruiting tools (e.g., ADP, SAP, Workday, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Experience with **Certified GreytHR software** or similar HR software tools for payroll, performance management, and HR analytics.
* In\-depth understanding of **payroll compliance**, **labor laws**, and **employee compensation** strategies.
* Ability to create compelling **job descriptions** and lead recruitment efforts to attract top talent.

description:

**About the role**
------------------


Rippling is looking for an Employee Relations Business Partner based in Bangalore, India to join its HR Policy \& Compliance Team to manage employee relations investigations.


You will work closely with a number of stakeholders, including HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Legal, and business leaders, on employee relations investigations.

**What you will do**

* Track employee relations activity, themes, resolution status, and outcomes in Rippling.
* Identify patterns, root causes, and emerging risks across employee relations matters, and recommend process, training, manager coaching, or policy improvements.
* Help develop and maintain employee relations operating practices, including intake criteria, escalation guidelines, documentation standards, investigation protocols, templates, and cadences.
* Leverage data, AI, and automation to improve employee relations processes, scale case handling, and create better experiences for employees and managers.
* Maintain discretion, confidentiality, neutrality, and professionalism when handling sensitive employee and workplace matters.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in employee relations, HR business partnership, HR compliance, workplace investigations, or a related HR role.
* Strong understanding of employee relations principles, workplace conduct standards, HR compliance considerations, and investigation best practices.
* Experience advising managers and business leaders on sensitive employee matters with sound judgment, discretion, neutrality, and empathy.
* Ability to assess employee relations concerns and determine the right path for HR\-led resolution, stakeholder partnership, or escalation to Legal, Compliance, Security, or another specialized team.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting case summaries, findings, recommendations, playbooks, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong interviewing, fact\-gathering, documentation, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Practical business judgment and strong HR instincts, with the ability to recommend solutions that are fair, consistent, risk\-aware, and operationally realistic.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple matters at once, prioritize urgent issues, and drive work to timely resolution.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with HRBPs, Legal, managers, executives, and other internal stakeholders.
* Ability to use data and case trends to identify recurring issues, improve processes, and support broader employee relations priorities.
* Comfort building structure, improving processes, and operating effectively in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* Interest in using AI and automation to scale HR processes and improve the employee and manager experience.

**Nice to have**

description:

 Job Description
   

  

**About Us**

 functional hardware; and HotSpring® spas. We leverage our powerful brands across product categories, sales
